fixedJitter.comparisonDefinition: All 640x480 RGB channels, 0..255; no masks, alignment or best-frame selection.
fixedJitter.imageReview: The complete 24-image contact sheet was inspected. The two burst captures agree closely with controlled retail; 16 non-burst controls are pixel-identical to uninstrumented images.

tests.initialWindowsInvocation: Outside the configured x86 environment the compiler targeted x64; the existing shared pointer-width guard rejected it. The x86-wrapper rerun passed.

limits: Instrumented constant-jitter results are separate from production image evidence.
Whole-process PRNG streams are not proven identical; no production random generator or seed changed.
Windows RTX uses SDR raster output, not native RT.
Broader SP/campaign, physical input, listening and feedback-device acceptance remain open.
cleanup: Local probes and build outputs retained as evidence in the designated project area; earlier cleanup-rejected files were not touched or retried.
